lessons.trigger_condition: V412 safely promoted six additional TCG categories from verified registry evidence, but several legacy collectors intentionally remained core-three specific. Without a separate bounded monitor, a promoted category could appear in the tablet UI while its official/market evidence and purchase links aged independently of the existing six-hour collection cycle.
lessons.prevention_rule: Keep the eight mandatory collectors and core-three precision parsers unchanged. After mandatory collection, probe only the registry-declared official and market URLs for promoted non-core games using bounded public-HTTPS requests, preserve prior verified evidence on outages, update only declarative registry evidence, dynamically add inventory-unverified purchase links, and feed only bounded non-directional source-health/catalog-depth/rarity attention into the existing market lens. Keep 17→12→18 neural shape, grading calibration gates, no profit or price-direction prediction, no stock invention, no runtime source rewrite and no Git write.
validation_required: V413 monitor probes promoted non-core registry official_source and market_source only
public HTTPS and bounded response limits remain mandatory
official source reachability marketplace catalog depth rarity keywords and date hints are evidence only
source outages preserve previous verified marketplace depth instead of erasing it
existing eight mandatory collection jobs remain unchanged and source monitoring is auxiliary
CI skips nondeterministic live probing while deterministic parser evidence tests remain required
purchase categories and generic TCG retailers use promoted registry purchase values while inventory remains explicitly unverified
legacy purchase-link probe budget remains reserved for existing curated retailers
tablet market lens receives only bounded promoted-source attention and can show a verified-source fallback card
market direction price rise stock and profit are not inferred
new-game grading remains disabled until separate calibration
screen neural remains exactly 17 inputs 12 hidden units and 18 allowlisted outputs
runtime source generation arbitrary commands Git/main writes user behavior tracking and verification bypass remain forbidden
physical tablet runtime remains unverified until device-side evidence exists
lessons.safety_boundary: V413 adds auxiliary promoted-TCG source health, marketplace-depth evidence, dynamic purchase-source coverage and UI attention only. It does not replace the core precision collectors, guarantee returns, predict price direction, claim stock, enable uncalibrated grading, track user behavior, rewrite runtime source, execute arbitrary commands, write Git/main, or bypass existing safety and neural promotion gates.
